title: YOUR STATS SAYS WHAT ITS NUMBER COUNTS
why: Seen on the 4K screenshot of the Mainframe (2026-10-09): the heading read YOUR STATS 7, a bare number. It is the runs logged, which the cards under it count from, so it now says 7 RUNS. The heading words are untouched.
now: The YOUR STATS heading now says how many runs it counts.

edits.replacement: document.getElementById('logct').textContent=P.log.length+(P.log.length===1?' RUN':' RUNS');   // v16.xx, from the 4K visual pass (2026-10-09): the heading read YOUR STATS 7, a number with nothing to say what it counts
